title: file

messages.description: if the file can't be opened or the end of the file is reached

arguments.description: function of [file]: handle, define, mkdir, which, glob, stat, isfile, isdirectory, size, copy, move, delete, split, join, splitext or splitname

body: [file] gives access to the file system. Its first argument selects the function; without one it is [file handle], which reads and writes files as lists of bytes.
